units.source_text: 最后她说，现在再弹奏一曲，于是看着谱子，弹起了《新曲浦岛》

en.t: Finally she said she would play one more piece, and, looking at the score, began playing New Urashima.

units.source_text: ［《新曲浦岛》，曲名，以浦岛的传说为题材的长歌。

en.t: [New Urashima is the title of a piece, a nagauta based on the legend of Urashima.

units.source_text: 由杵屋勘五郎和寒玉作曲］。

en.t: It was composed by Kineya Kangoro and Kangyoku].

units.source_text: 弹完之后，她把拨子夹在琴弦上，姿势也就随便了。

en.t: After she finished playing, she tucked the plectrum among the strings and let her posture relax.
